uplink.description: cyclic event: all 8 open-collector channels off (contact open), supply 5.021 V
uplink._note: TTN example. 0x07 output-states bitfield 0x00 -> every channel off, so all eight channels[] entries read 'open'. supply 0x139D=5021 mV -> 5.021 V. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (ch1..ch8 all 0, supply_voltage 5021, tx_reason CYCLIC_EVENT).

uplink.description: open-collector channels 1 and 3 on -> oc0/oc2 closed
uplink._note: 0x07 bitfield 0x05 -> bit0 (ELV ch1 -> oc0) and bit2 (ch3 -> oc2) set. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (ch1=1, ch3=1, others 0).

uplink.description: mixed bitfield 0xA9: channels 1/4/6/8 on -> oc0/oc3/oc5/oc7 closed, plus interval and contact-interface mode
uplink._note: Multi-position vector with an asymmetric bitfield so a bit-order bug fails: 0xA9 = 1010_1001b -> bits 0,3,5,7 set (ELV ch1, ch4, ch6, ch8), bits 1,2,4,6 clear; the bit-reversed byte would be 0x95, a different expectation. Also exercises 0x08 interval (15) and 0x09 contact-interface mode enabled (a whole-device config flag, kept top-level — the contact interface watches the same eight terminals, it is not a second bank). Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (ch1=1, ch2=0, ch3=0, ch4=1, ch5=0, ch6=1, ch7=0, ch8=1, interval 15, contact_interface_en 1, supply_voltage 5021, tx_reason INPUT_1_EVENT).

uplink.description: config-only uplink (no 0x07 record): channels omitted entirely
uplink._note: Version records (0x01/0x02) plus interval (0x08) and no 0x07 output-states record: the frame carries no position readings, so `channels` is omitted rather than emitted empty. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (app_version V1.0.1, bl_version V3.0.7, interval 60, no chN keys).
